user.title: Connect The Wash Guide
user.description: In The Wash Guide app, open Settings, find Smart home, and tap Generate connect key. Paste the key here. The control key is optional: it lets Home Assistant act as well as read (post a task, ask the house for a maintenance wash, log a clean), and it needs PRO. You can add it later.

error.invalid_auth: That key was not accepted. Generate a fresh one in the app and try again.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach The Wash Guide cloud. Check your connection and try again.
error.invalid_control_key: That control key was not accepted. Generate a fresh one in the app and try again.
error.not_control_key: That is a connect key, not a control key. Connect keys can only read. Generate a control key in the app (it needs PRO) and paste that one here.

init.title: The Wash Guide
init.description: A control key lets Home Assistant act as well as read: post a task to the household board, ask the house for a maintenance wash, and record the clean when the cycle finishes. Generate one in the app under Settings, Smart home; it needs PRO. Leave the box empty to take the ability to act away again, and reading carries on as before.
